Game Day Guide: Dallas Stars at Vegas Golden Knights

away.summary: The Dallas Stars (12-6-2) are in strong form, having won four of their last five games against Vegas and riding a six-game point streak from Wyatt Johnston against the Golden Knights. Miro Heiskanen is projected to return to the lineup after missing five games with an upper-body injury, while Tyler Myers will not play after leaving Sunday's game. Jason Robertson leads the Stars in goals and is tied for the team lead in points with 22 in 20 games.

home.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights (13-6-3) are coming off a 6-3 loss to the Vancouver Canucks and are 1-1-1 in their last three games. Mark Stone leads the team in goals (11) and is tied for the franchise lead in points with 417, while Jack Eichel leads the team in scoring with 28 points. Noah Hanifin is injured with an undisclosed injury, and Ivan Barbashev moves down to the third line with Trevor Connelly taking his spot on the second line.
